name: Quantity Breakdown 70
definition: Details of breakdown of a quantity.

LotNumber.name: Lot Number
LotNumber.definition: Identification, for tax purposes, of a lot of identical securities that are bought at a certain date and at a certain price.

LotQuantity.name: Lot Quantity
LotQuantity.definition: Quantity of financial instruments that is part of the lot described.

LotDateTime.name: Lot Date Time
LotDateTime.definition: Date/time at which the lot was purchased.

LotPrice.name: Lot Price
LotPrice.definition: Price at which the lot was purchased.

TypeOfPrice.name: Type Of Price
TypeOfPrice.definition: Specifies the type of price and information about the price.

AccountBaseCurrencyAmounts.name: Account Base Currency Amounts
AccountBaseCurrencyAmounts.definition: Valuation amounts for the lot provided in the base currency of the account.

InstrumentCurrencyAmounts.name: Instrument Currency Amounts
InstrumentCurrencyAmounts.definition: Valuation amounts for the lot provided in the currency of the financial instrument.

AlternateReportingCurrencyAmounts.name: Alternate Reporting Currency Amounts
AlternateReportingCurrencyAmounts.definition: Valuation amounts for the lot provided in a currency  other than the base currency of the account.
